title: The session settings that change results
description: `spark.sql.ansi.enabled` (true by default since 4.0) switches overflow, division by zero, casts, indexes and string coercion between raising and NULL or wrapping, and changes type coercion (`FLOAT + INT`, `'1' + 1`); it also sets `size(NULL)` (`spark.sql.legacy.sizeOfNull`) and the text of decimals cast to strings. `spark.sql.timestampType` decides what `TIMESTAMP` means, `spark.sql.session.timeZone` how `TIMESTAMP_LTZ` reads and prints. `spark.sql.legacy.statisticalAggregate` turns the NULLs of degenerate `var_samp`, `covar_samp`, `corr` into NaN. `spark.sql.decimalOperations.allowPrecisionLoss` decides the result scale past 38 digits. `spark.sql.timeType.enabled` enables `TIME`. `spark.sql.shuffle.partitions` and the cluster's parallelism change the order of double sums, `first`, `collect_list` and ties (spark-exec-parallel). Outside Spark's configuration, the JVM's default locale changes `upper` and `lower` (spark-case).

sverify's Spark session sets ANSI on, UTC, `TIMESTAMP_NTZ`, case-sensitive names and unescaped string literals (`sverify_spark.dialect.SPARK_CONF`); the probes ran with those, and each fact records the settings it was checked under.
reference: The reference has no settings. A profile's facts hold under the settings they record (`sverify._engine_settings`, #444); the Spark row needs ANSI on and the settings of `SPARK_CONF`.

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_spark` runs each query four times on one local session: with `spark.sql.ansi.enabled` true and false, on the folded path (the optimizer evaluates a query over `VALUES` on the driver) and on the codegen path (`ConvertToLocalRelation` and `ConstantFolding` excluded, so the query runs as a job with whole-stage code generation). probes.json keeps one result per ANSI setting where the two paths agree. Spark 4.3.0 (pyspark 4.3.0), Java 21.0.12, Linux x86_64, `local[2]`, session time zone UTC, `spark.sql.timestampType=TIMESTAMP_NTZ`.

evidence.note: `try_add(1, (2147483647 + 1))`: the inner `+` raises `ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW` with ANSI on
the same query with ANSI off: the inner `+` wraps, result -2147483647
`size(arrays_zip(..., null, ...))` is NULL with ANSI on
the same query with ANSI off is -1 (`spark.sql.legacy.sizeOfNull` follows ANSI)
`12345678912345.123456789123 / 0.000000012345678` is a `decimal(38,9)` with `allowPrecisionLoss` on (default), ANSI on
the same division after `set spark.sql.decimalOperations.allowPrecisionLoss=false` is typed `decimal(38,18)` and raises `NUMERIC_VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE.WITH_SUGGESTION` with ANSI on
with precision loss off and ANSI off it is NULL, a `decimal(38,18)`

provenance.notes: Spark's SQL query tests at tag v4.3.0: the golden files under results/ run with ANSI on, those under results/nonansi/ with it off.

notes: `python -m sverify_dev.spark_fuzz --rows 300 --seed 738`: random rows leaning on the fact's edges, each construct run with spark.sql.ansi.enabled on and off, on the folded and the codegen path, and compared with a model of this fact (value, result type, error class). 17942 of 17942 results as the fact says; Spark's value differs from Rel.eval's (sverify's lift, reference profile) on 0 of 283 rows compared.
It exercises spark.sql.ansi.enabled on and off throughout; size(NULL) under each; spark.sql.legacy.statisticalAggregate on and off for var_samp.

list_index[0]: 300 rows, `element_at(a, i)`, `a[i]`, `get(a, i)`, `try_element_at(a, i)`, `size(a)`, `array_size(a)`, 6326 of 6326 results as the fact says (raised: INVALID_ARRAY_INDEX 30, INVALID_ARRAY_INDEX_IN_ELEMENT_AT 28, INVALID_INDEX_OF_ZERO 92); aggregates[1]: 300 rows, `var_samp(x)`, `var_pop(x)`, `stddev_samp(x)`, 1440 of 1440 results as the fact says; int_divide[3]: 300 rows, `a div b`, `a / b`, 2394 of 2394 results as the fact says (raised: ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW 2, DIVIDE_BY_ZERO 58); Spark differs from Rel.eval on 0 of 283; fp32[0]: 300 rows, `a + b`, `a * b`, `a / b`, `a + i`, `sqrt(a)`, 5970 of 5970 results as the fact says (raised: DIVIDE_BY_ZERO 30); raise_set[0]: 300 rows, `n + s`, `element_at(a, i)`, 1812 of 1812 results as the fact says (raised: CAST_INVALID_INPUT 30, INVALID_ARRAY_INDEX_IN_ELEMENT_AT 21, INVALID_INDEX_OF_ZERO 39).
Spark 4.3.0, Java 21.0.12.1, Linux amd64, local[2], session time zone UTC.
